title: Untitled (Guernica with CDs)
description: Monochrome photographic imagery of a WWII German warplane viewed from below occupies the upper half, while scattered compact discs and cassette-tape mechanisms populate the lower section against a pale architectural background. Iridescent CDs labeled 'SKILCRAFT' are distributed across the composition alongside chain-linked cassette reels.
composition: warplane above scattered CDs and cassettes
